w: Swamishri visited the new mandir site and sanctified it and performed the Bhumi pujan ceremony.
At 7.00pm, Swamishri blessed a Medico-Spiritual Conference and thereafter went for darshan to the Sanatan Mandir and attended the evening assembly.

During a conversation with Swamishri on internet chatting, someone added that the kishores of Tampa have given up internet chatting after the shibir in Perry, Georgia. Before Swamishri responded, Vijay clarified, "After the shibir in Perry, we have cut down on chatting but not stopped entirely. The reason being that we've been chatting with friends for three years so it takes time ..." Swamishri responded immediately, "Stop it altogether. At this age you should focus on your studies and Satsang. Make an effort to make your life better and beautiful. In chatting, you will waste time and spoil your studies. Your mind will always think about that and its vices will corrupt you. Therefore, study properly and you will achieve happiness and wealth." A youth added, "Bapa, I used to chat before ..." Swamishri interrupted, "Now give it up entirely. Put your efforts in studying as best you can. Because after chatting you will experience an upsetting. Your mind will be upset. And then, preoccupied with those thoughts your academic performance will decline. There is no need for such enticing things." The kishores received Swamishri's loving, direct advice and pledged to give up chatting.
Like this hospital that helps cure physical disease, the way to cure our inner disease lies in reading our scriptures, 'sant samagam' and devotion to God.
We attain the benefits of academic study, but the root of all knowledge is God.
Pujya Shastriji Maharaj Shraddh festival was cancelled and instead prayer-assembly was held in honor of those who had died and were injured in the terrorist attack in Akshardham.

pr.t: The Right to Eat for All
w: After the morning assembly, Swamishri passed by an almond tree while returning to his residence.
There were many almond fruits lying on the ground. A sadhu commented, "Parrots eat a lot of almond fruits."
"Let them eat. Is it that you only require to eat? Don't they need to eat too!" Swamishri replied.
"I don't mind them eating, but they eat only half and throw the rest away," the sadhu added.
"When they eat, they may throw it away. God has so created that every being has a right to eat."
Swamishri's appreciation for God's creatures and the right to their innate habit of eating throws a new light on our ways of living in harmony with nature.
Mahayagna Nagar Yatra Swamishri arrived in Kisumu at 11.00 am following a 30-minite flight from Nairobi.
The Yagna for World Peace was in progress in the mandir when Swamishri arrived at his residence.

In the afternoon a grand procession of the murtis to be consecrated in the new mandir took place. The murtis were housed in beautifully decorated floats and paraded through the streets of Kisumu. In the evening Swamishri attended the welcome assembly in which the Hindu Council of Kenya presented a Special Citation to Swamishri in honour of his work to promote world peace and harmony.
